text_block_list.text:
How romantic the rivalries that spur
personal
growth, like chestnuts roasting
on an open fire!
...What is Голд Шип
even talking about?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her idioms may be cryptic, but her
victory in the
autumn Tenno Sho is clear
as day. With a rematch
against Tosen
Jordan on the horizon, a new clue
has
fallen into Голд Шип's lap. Splendid!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The night after the race, Голд Шипп has a
dream
again. In it, a voice calls her a
"ship of gold," but
the speaker's identity
remains hidden.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп realizes Накаяма Феста's
voice
sounds surprisingly similar to the
one in her
dream. The speaker's identity
is slowly coming to
light.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
